author: Alfred de Musset
description: "The Confession of a Child of the Century" by Alfred de Musset is a novel written during the early 19th century, specifically in the context of the Romantic period.
longDescription: The narrative unfolds through the reflections of its protagonist, Octave, a young man grappling with the emotional turmoil stemming from a failed romantic relationship and the broader disillusionment of his generation in post-Napoleonic France.

authorInfo.bio: Alfred de Musset (1810–1857) wrote The Confession of a Child of the Century — Complete. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
